_readme: Marketplace links and prices per product. Key: the product slug from its page URL (remen.uz/product/<slug>). Per marketplace (uzum, ozon, yandex, wb, optom): url = the product card on that marketplace, price = its price there in UZS (optional: without it the site price plus the markup in lib/marketplaces.ts is shown). A marketplace left out links to its search for the product name instead. Example: "252-zubcatyi-remen-tip-75-t5-1400": { "uzum": { "url": "https://uzum.uz/...", "price": 2250000 } }
